scope: Bounded, source-text assertions from the ATCT DOAH-T1 sequence of operation on MI730 (source PDF page 64). It identifies key control logic, safeties, alarms and setpoints without claiming that the remainder of the 75-page document has been sequence-audited.
coordinate_system: Displayed PDF page, points, top-left origin; 2448 x 1584.

visual_review.finding: The full MI730 page was visually reviewed at 180 DPI. The sequence occupies both lower text columns beneath the DOAH schematic; each assertion is independently bounded to one source column.

sequence_scope.sheet_title: ATCT DOAH - Control Schematic and Points List

assertions.expected: DOAH SHALL BE ENABLED THROUGH THE FACILITY DDC SYSTEM
FIRE ALARM PANEL (FAP) SIGNAL THAT TAKES PRECEDENCE OVER ALL OTHER VFD INPUTS
SUPPLY FAN SHALL START AND RUN CONTINUOUSLY, SUBJECT TO SAFETIES
SUPPLY FAN SHALL RUN SUBJECT TO THE SUPPLY FAN START/STOP SIGNAL (SF-SS) AND SAFETIES
FAILURE OF ANY PROOF OR ACTIVATION OF ANY SAFETY SHALL RESULT IN ALL CONTROL LOOPS BEING DISABLED AND THE FAN BEING COMMANDED OFF UNTIL RESET
PREHEAT COIL DISCHARGE AIR TEMPERATURE LOW LIMIT (FREEZESTAT)
OUTSIDE AIR DAMPERS SHALL BE COMMANDED OPEN, ONCE THE DAMPERS ARE PROVEN OPEN
CAPACITY MODULATION OUTPUT TO THE VFD SHALL BE ZERO PERCENT AND DOAH DAMPERS SHALL BE CLOSED
PREHEAT COIL ENTERING AIR TEMPERATURE DROPS BELOW 35°F
CHW VALVE SHALL MODULATE TO MAINTAIN THE DOAH COOLING COIL DISCHARGE SETPOINT
REHEAT HHW VALVE SHALL MODULATE TO MAINTAIN DOAH DISCHARGE SETPOINT
GLOBAL OA TEMPERATURE SENSOR INDICATES A DRY BULB TEMPERATURE OF LESS THAN 40°F
DISABLE DOAH AND CLOSE INTAKE DAMPERS
OUTSIDE AIR FLOW OUT OF RANGE: +/-10% OR MODE FROM SCHEDULED VALUE
SUPPLY AIR DIRTY MERV 13 FILTER SWITCH: 1.00" WG
